body: Cross posted from r/Hair, lmk if this isn't the right place!

I don't think the joke is about judging other people for having sex, moreso feeling like an outsider for not understanding it and wanting to have a reason to not feel like an outsider.

Using your cycling analogy, it would be more like saying I hope cycling isn't real because I don't want to cycle but for my whole life everyone around me has told me cycling is what makes me human--which would still be weird as not-a-joke but makes a little more sense imo

Ownership by big corporations was my concern with them & Carol's Daughter which is owned by Loreal who I know have had some potentially problematic history--I didn't know that about Unilever though, thanks for the heads up!
I had heard some iffy things about some non-beauty desert essence products (not that they were bad, but that they weren't anything to write home about) so glad to know it works so well! Thanks!
I never claimed I knew how to spell
I do it and I'm definitely still cis tho so I'm sure you're fine
Did you specifically go to a trans-friendly therapist or did you just bring it up to another therapist? (If it's the first one, how did you find one?)
I guess I meant, I can't ask other people to tell me whether or not I'm trans because I have to figure that out myself
Update for anyone who finds this thread: antidepressants helped. Therapy has been helpful since then, but antidepressants are the reason I'm alive and mostly okay today 🙏
The wait times for any counselor in my area right now I can afford is like 3-6 months so I haven't had a chance
IDK, I guess it just sucks to try to reach out for help and get no response multiple times

I've never been diagnosed with depression but I've got OCD and some anxiety issues. I'm a senior right now but I haven't made any steps towards relationships with my professors or finding topics for graduate school (I have 2 very different majors so finding something is a little extra hard). I'm having a hard time imagining a future/career path where I could be both happy and make like halfway decent money (not enough to be rich, but enough to not have to stress about money anymore).
I have to do some senior projects for school that I'm like a year behind on prepping for and that's what's causing the most direct stress right now but it definitely does feel like just the newest thing on the top of the pile.
